subject: history
concept: Understanding that people around the world speak different languages and this reflects different cultures
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student learns a few simple greeting words from a different language
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a greeting word to the region/language it comes from
exercise.abstract: Student explains why people in different parts of the world might speak different languages

assessment.success_marker: student engages respectfully and curiously with linguistic diversity
